dialogue.text: Hi everybody and welcome to this video.
dialogue.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這個影片。
dialogue.ja: みなさん、こんにちは。このビデオへようこそ。
dialogue.local: Hi everybody and welcome to this video.
dialogue.en: Hi everybody and welcome to this video.

dialogue.text: In this video, we're going to talk about subjective pronouns.
dialogue.zh: 在這個影片中，我們將討論主格代名詞。
dialogue.ja: このビデオでは、主格代名詞について話します。
dialogue.local: In this video, we're going to talk about subjective pronouns.
dialogue.en: In this video, we're going to talk about subjective pronouns.

dialogue.text: So let's take a look at the board.
dialogue.zh: 那麼，讓我們來看看黑板。
dialogue.ja: では、黒板を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: So let's take a look at the board.
dialogue.en: So let's take a look at the board.

dialogue.text: Here they are, the subjective pronouns.
dialogue.ja: こちらが主格代名詞です。
dialogue.local: Here they are, the subjective pronouns.
dialogue.en: Here they are, the subjective pronouns.

dialogue.zh: 它們在英語中非常重要。
dialogue.ja: 英語ではとても大切です。

dialogue.text: So the first subjective pronoun is I.
dialogue.zh: 第一個主格代名詞是 I。
dialogue.ja: 最初の主格代名詞は「I」です。
dialogue.local: So the first subjective pronoun is I.
dialogue.en: So the first subjective pronoun is I.

dialogue.ja: 「I」は「私」を意味します。私はエスターです。

dialogue.text: Now he is only used for boys or men.
dialogue.zh: He 只用於男孩或男人。
dialogue.ja: 「He」は男の子や男性にだけ使います。
dialogue.local: Now he is only used for boys or men.
dialogue.en: Now he is only used for boys or men.

dialogue.text: So another boy or man is he.
dialogue.zh: 另一個男孩或男人也是 he。
dialogue.ja: 別の男の子や男性も「he」です。
dialogue.local: So another boy or man is he.
dialogue.en: So another boy or man is he.

dialogue.text: She is used for girls or women.
dialogue.ja: 「She」は女の子や女性に使います。
dialogue.local: She is used for girls or women.
dialogue.en: She is used for girls or women.

dialogue.text: It is used for a place like a school,
dialogue.zh: It 用於像學校這樣的地方，
dialogue.ja: 「It」は学校のような場所に使います。
dialogue.local: It is used for a place like a school,
dialogue.en: It is used for a place like a school,

dialogue.ja: 犬のような動物にも使います。

dialogue.text: or a thing like a chair.
dialogue.ja: 椅子のような物にも使います。
dialogue.local: or a thing like a chair.
dialogue.en: or a thing like a chair.

dialogue.text: We means other people and me.
dialogue.ja: 「We」は他の人たちと私を意味します。
dialogue.local: We means other people and me.
dialogue.en: We means other people and me.

dialogue.text: And the last one is they.
dialogue.local: And the last one is they.
dialogue.en: And the last one is they.

dialogue.ja: 「They」は多くの人や場所を意味します。
動物や物にも使います。
主格代名詞を使います。

dialogue.local: I hope you guys have a good understanding of when and how to use them.
dialogue.en: I hope you guys have a good understanding of when and how to use them.
